name: Deadmire's Tooth
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, Deadmire stalks the murky waters, and his tooth marks an honorable hunt. Melor Stonehoof on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff receives it as proof that the ancient crocolisk's suffering has ended.

sections.title: A Trophy of Mercy
sections.body: Tauren hunters on Hunter Rise see the hunt as a bond of balance, reverence, and mercy. Deadmire was once among the most magnificent crocolisks in Dustwallow Marsh. Great age turned his final years to torment, though he kept the fierce spirit of his prime. His massive bones and failing body had become a prison of pain. Deadmire's Tooth gives Melor Stonehoof proof that an honorable hunt has ended the beast's suffering.

faq.q: What is Deadmire's Tooth used for?
aliases: what do i do with deadmire tooth
faq.answer: Bring the tooth to Melor Stonehoof on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. It completes the hunt he assigns and proves Deadmire has been given a merciful release.

faq.q: Where does Deadmire's Tooth come from?
faq.answer: Deadmire's Tooth comes from Deadmire, an enormous ancient crocolisk in southern Dustwallow Marsh. He roams the waters east of Tabetha's Farm.

faq.q: Why does Melor Stonehoof want Deadmire killed?
faq.answer: Melor Stonehoof sees Deadmire as a noble creature enduring terrible pain in old age. The hunt offers mercy, letting the crocolisk's flame pass peacefully instead of leaving him to waste away in torment.

angles.text: As a hunter learning from the mentors of Hunter Rise, you learn that the hunt calls for respect and mercy as well as the pursuit of trophies.
As a tauren, you see Deadmire's hunt as part of the Earth Mother's cycle of balance. Elderly predators are guided toward peace instead of being left to suffer.
